body.statement:
In the two-armed bounded-reward contextual-bandit model of Perchet and Rigollet, with \(\beta\in(0,1]\), \(\alpha>0\), their H\"older condition, their local margin condition, and a context density bounded above and below on \([0,1]^d\), Theorem 5.1 gives an explicit policy with expected regret at most a constant times
\[
T^{(\beta+d-\alpha\beta)/(2\beta+d)}.
\]
The paragraph immediately following that theorem states that, for two arms, the same order is minimax optimal up to a multiplicative constant.

source.locator: Theorem 5.1 and the minimax-optimality paragraph immediately following it
source.verbatim_statement: Fix $\beta\in(0,1]$, $L>0$, $\alpha>0$, assume that $n \ge K\log(K)$ and consider a problem in $\cM^K_{\cX}(\alpha,\beta,L)$. If $\alpha<\infty$, then the \textsc{abse} policy $\tpi$ has an expected regret at time $n$ bounded by \[ \E R_n(\tpi)\le C n \biggl(\frac{K\log(K)}{n} \biggr)^{{\beta (\alpha+1)}/({2\beta+d})}, \] where $C>0$ does not depend on $K$. Note that the bounds given in Theorem~\ref{THmainadap} are optimal in a minimax sense when $K=2$. Indeed, the lower bounds of \cite{AudTsy07} and~\cite{RigZee10} imply that the bound on expected regret cannot be improved as a function of $n$ except for a constant multiplicative term.

upstream.citation: Jean-Yves Audibert and Alexandre B. Tsybakov, Fast learning rates for plug-in classifiers, Annals of Statistics 35 (2007), DOI 10.1214/009053606000001217; Philippe Rigollet and Assaf Zeevi, Nonparametric bandits with covariates, COLT 2010, pp. 54-66
upstream.locator: Lower bounds cited in the paragraph immediately following Perchet-Rigollet Theorem 5.1

attestation.note: Verified directly against the primary arXiv v3 TeX source archive for arXiv:1110.6084 (aos1101.tex, source marker th5.1 / label THmainadap). For fixed K=2, algebraically simplifying the displayed exponent gives (beta+d-alpha beta)/(2 beta+d). Sections 3.1-3.2 define bounded rewards, Holder arm means, local margin alpha>0, and two-sided density bounds. The following paragraph explicitly attributes minimax lower-bound provenance to the two works recorded as upstream.
